sanskrit: dūre prakṣepayettasmāt tannimālyaṃ na cā kramāt ||
suptvā bhuktvā jalaṃ pītvā kṛtvā cāvaśyakaṃ prati ||
aṅgagāni ca vighnāni vināśaṃ yānti śāsmṛtam ||
yo taṃ śubhaṃ sūkṣmaṃsitaṃ kāṣāyameva vā ||?
nāti sthūlaṃ kṛśaṃ chinnaṃ grathitaṃ likhitatviṣam ||
hṛdi nābhau ca pṛṣṭhe ca jānunoḥ pādayostathā ||
hṛdaye īśvaraḥ proktaḥ nābhau caiva prajāpatiḥ ||
hṛdgataṃ tacca vijñāya bhūyo bhūyaḥ pibettadā ||
taiḥ śuddhaiḥ śuddhadehaḥ syāt śuddha bhāvaśca sādhakaḥ ||
bāhyo vāpi tanoḥ śuddhiḥ pṛthivyā salilena ca ||
kintu tadbhāva saṃśuddhyā śuddhaṃ bhāvādi tanmanaḥ ||
gṛhastho brahmacārī ca pūrvaṃ vandeta vaidikam ||
punaḥ śaivīṃ yatī yadvā sandhyāmeva śivātmikām ||
vaidikīṃ tu purākṛtvā tataḥ śaivī * * * * bhyaset ||
śaivī tu niyame naiva sevyā patanamanyathā ||
vaiśvadevaṃ tathā sandhyā śūdraṃ tyaktvātraye hitam || iti ||
sā sandhyā bindu nādānta samanā śakti gāminī ||
evaṃ sandhyāḥ sadā vandyāḥ sākṣiṇyaḥ sarvakarmaṇām ||
